But they want to check different options. They want to compute cost. So we can compute cost. Then provide estimated total payable amount. But maybe we need to also consider insurance? Not specified. So just cost.

We need to call get_flight_cost. But we need travel_from and travel_to. We need to get list of airports. So call list_all_airports. Then get first and last. Then call get_flight_cost. Then provide cost.

Thus we need to call list_all_airports.
